brief:
An Israeli airstrike struck near Muawiya Mosque on Al-Rashid Street in western Rafah, in southern Gaza, killing two people, the Ma'an news agency reported. The strike targeted an area in the city's western sector, where the mosque is located along the main commercial thoroughfare.

No further details on the identities of the casualties or additional damage from the strike were immediately available.
title: Israeli airstrike kills two near mosque in western Rafah
